content.prompt:
True or False? Let $A$ and $B$ be sets in a universal set $U$.

$A\cap\overline B=(A\cup B)\cap\overline B$.

answer.worked: True. Intersecting $A\cup B$ with $\overline B$ removes every element in $B$, leaving exactly the elements of $A$ outside $B$. These form $A\cap\overline B$.
